name: Brew Updates
tagline: Keep Homebrew updated, backed up and scanned for vulnerabilities, on autopilot.
summary: A Mac app that keeps Homebrew and everything you installed with it updated, backed up, health-checked and scanned for vulnerabilities on a schedule, then shows you exactly what changed. Set it up once and forget about brew upgrade.
requirements: Apple silicon Mac · macOS 15 Sequoia or later · Homebrew

hero.alt: Brew Updates dashboard showing the last run, schedule, available updates, security findings and doctor status

tour.alt: Animated tour of the Brew Updates app: Dashboard, Installed, Runs, Security, Doctor and Backups

features.title: Unattended updates
features.text: Runs brew update, upgrades outdated formulae and casks, and cleans up on your schedule: daily, weekly or monthly. Pinned and excluded packages are left alone.

features.title: A backup before every run
features.text: Each run saves a Brewfile first. Compare any backup with what's installed and restore missing taps, formulae and casks in a click.

features.title: Security scanning built in
features.text: Every run scans with Grype and brew vulns (OSV.dev), with a severity filter and a trend chart so you can see whether things are getting better.

features.title: Health checks explained
features.text: brew doctor warnings come with plain-English explanations and copyable fixes, plus a list of deprecated packages and suggested replacements.

features.title: Know what to clean up
features.text: See packages nothing needs any more, packages Homebrew is retiring, and packages with security issues worth upgrading, replacing or removing.

features.title: Menu bar at a glance
features.text: The menu bar icon shows how many updates are waiting. One notification per run, and clicking it opens that run's details.

quickStart.title: Install
quickStart.text: Install with Homebrew, or download the notarized DMG from the latest release and drag Brew Updates to Applications.

quickStart.title: Open it
quickStart.text: Open Brew Updates from Applications. macOS asks once about opening an app from the internet: click Open.

quickStart.title: Choose when it runs
quickStart.text: Pick Daily, Weekly or Monthly and a time, leave notifications on, and click Install grype for the deeper security scan. Then click Set Up.

quickStart.title: Let it run
quickStart.text: Updates now run on schedule even when the app is closed. The app also keeps itself up to date and asks before installing a new version.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.text: Last run, schedule, available updates, security counts, doctor status and system versions.

screens.name: Installed
screens.text: Formulae and casks with their dependencies. Pin, exclude, upgrade selected, or uninstall safely.

screens.name: Runs
screens.text: Every run's summary and log, plus live output for runs started from the app.

screens.name: Security
screens.text: Grype and brew vulns findings with a severity filter, trend chart and on-demand Scan Now.

screens.name: Doctor
screens.text: Each brew doctor warning explained, with copyable fixes and replacement suggestions.

screens.name: Backups
screens.text: Compare Brewfile backups and restore missing taps, formulae and casks.

faq.question: Is it safe to install?
faq.answer: Yes. The app is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple, and its updates are signed too, so only official releases are installed. All of the source code is on GitHub.

faq.question: Does it send my data anywhere?
faq.answer: No. There's no account and no analytics. It only talks to Homebrew, the vulnerability databases and GitHub (for its own updates).

faq.question: Does the app need to stay open?
faq.answer: No. Scheduled updates run even when the app is closed. The app is there to show results and let you act on them.

faq.question: Does it update my other apps?
faq.answer: Apps you installed with Homebrew (brew install --cask), yes, except apps that update themselves. App Store apps and apps you installed yourself aren't touched.

name: Cloud Status Hub
tagline: AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP health in one live view, with outage alerts and AI briefs.
summary: Stop checking four status pages. Cloud Status Hub pulls AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud and Google Cloud health into one dashboard that refreshes every minute, emails you when a provider you follow has an incident, and explains each incident in plain language.
requirements: Any modern browser · No sign-up needed

hero.alt: Cloud Status Hub showing AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP status cards and active incidents

features.title: Four clouds, one view
features.text: Current status of AWS, Azure, OCI and GCP side by side, refreshed every 60 seconds, with links to each official status page.

features.title: Region and service detail
features.text: Expand a provider to see exactly which regions and services are affected, not just a red or green light.

features.title: Email alerts
features.text: Follow the providers you care about and get an email when they report a new incident, and again when it's resolved.

features.title: AI Insight briefs
features.text: Each incident gets an AI-written technical brief and executive brief, viewable on the dashboard and downloadable as a PDF.

features.title: 90 days of history
features.text: Resolved incidents stay available for 90 days, so you can look back at what happened and when.

features.title: Per-provider pages
features.text: Bookmark /aws, /azure, /gcp or /oci to go straight to the provider you work with most.

quickStart.title: Open the dashboard
quickStart.text: No account or install needed. Leave it open in a tab; it refreshes itself every minute.

quickStart.title: Focus on your provider
quickStart.text: Use the filter bar at the top, or bookmark a provider page such as cloudstatus.synepho.com/aws.

quickStart.title: Dig into an incident
quickStart.text: Expand a provider card to see affected regions, then open an incident for its AI brief and a link to the official notice.

quickStart.title: Get alerts
quickStart.text: Click Get alerts, choose your providers and enter your email. Confirm from the email you receive and you're subscribed.

relatedPost.label: Read: Building Cloud Status Hub with AI Insight

name: AWS Services Dashboard
tagline: See which AWS services run in which regions, updated daily from AWS itself.
summary: Planning a deployment in a new region? AWS Services Dashboard shows every AWS service across every AWS region, refreshed daily from AWS's own metadata, with searchable region and service pages, a full coverage matrix and one-click Excel and CSV exports.
requirements: Any modern browser · No sign-up needed

hero.alt: AWS Services Dashboard showing region, service and mapping counts

features.title: Every region, every service
features.text: Availability for 400+ AWS services across all AWS regions, so you can check before you design.

features.title: Updated daily from AWS
features.text: Data comes from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store, AWS's own source of service metadata, and refreshes every day at 2:00 AM UTC.

features.title: Region and service pages
features.text: Every region and every service has its own page listing what is and isn't available, ready to bookmark or share.

features.title: Coverage matrix
features.text: A full service-by-region grid with filters, so gaps in a region you're considering stand out immediately.

features.title: Multi-term search
features.text: Search for several things at once: "lambda, s3" finds both services, "us-, ap-" finds every US and Asia Pacific region.

features.title: Excel and CSV reports
features.text: The Report Center exports a formatted Excel workbook or quick CSVs of regions, services and coverage.

quickStart.title: Open the dashboard
quickStart.text: No sign-up needed. The home page shows region, service and coverage totals with the last update time.

quickStart.title: Check a region
quickStart.text: Go to Regions and search, for example "us-, eu-", then open a region to see which services it has and which it's missing.

quickStart.title: Check a service
quickStart.text: Go to Services and search for what you need, such as "bedrock, lambda", to see every region that supports it.

quickStart.title: Export a report
quickStart.text: Open the Report Center to download the Excel workbook or a CSV for your architecture review or planning doc.

name: Lawn.Smart
tagline: A month-by-month lawn care plan tuned to your USDA hardiness zone.
summary: Know exactly what your lawn needs this month. Lawn.Smart builds a lawn care plan for your state and USDA hardiness zone, prioritizes the tasks that can't wait, tracks what you've done year over year, and installs on your phone like a native app.
requirements: Any modern browser · Installs to your home screen · Free

hero.alt: Lawn.Smart dashboard with this month's prioritized lawn care tasks and product picks

features.title: Tuned to your zone
features.text: Covers all 50 states and USDA hardiness zones 3a to 11b, so timing is right for where you actually live.

features.title: Priorities that matter
features.text: Tasks are ranked Critical, High, Medium or Low, and time-sensitive work like pre-emergent is surfaced first.

features.title: Calendar and history
features.text: See the whole month at a glance, then track what you completed year over year with streaks and a monthly notes journal.

features.title: Product picks
features.text: Recommendations matched to this month's tasks, so you know what to buy before you head to the store.

features.title: Built for your phone
features.text: A dedicated mobile layout puts your most important task up front, with a full three-column view on desktop.

features.title: Install it, use it offline
features.text: Add it to your home screen like a native app. It works offline and can remind you about seasonal tasks.

quickStart.title: Open Lawn.Smart
quickStart.text: Free, with no account needed.

quickStart.title: Set your location
quickStart.text: Enter your zip code, or choose your state, and click Get Started. Your USDA zone and season are set for you.

quickStart.title: Work this month's plan
quickStart.text: Start with the Critical task at the top and check tasks off as you go. Use Calendar to look ahead and History to see your progress.

quickStart.title: Add it to your home screen
quickStart.text: On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen in Safari. On Android, tap Install app in Chrome. Settings has step-by-step guides.

name: Tesla Drive Companion
tagline: Weather, traffic, news and EV chargers in one touch-friendly page for your Tesla's browser.
summary: A homepage made for the Tesla in-car browser. It brings the weather, live drive times to your saved places, the news and nearby chargers into one big, touch-friendly screen that follows your car's day and night display.
requirements: Tesla in-car browser, or any desktop or mobile browser

hero.alt: Tesla Drive Companion weather tab with current conditions, driving insight and 5-day forecast

features.title: Weather for driving
features.text: Current conditions, a 12-hour trend and 5-day forecast, plus a driving insight that estimates cold-weather range loss.

features.title: Live drive times
features.text: Save up to four places like Home and Work to see live drive and arrival times, plus traffic incidents near you.

features.title: EV chargers nearby
features.text: Find the nearest chargers with plug types, speed and stalls, Tesla-compatible first, along with food and other stops.

features.title: News at a glance
features.text: Headlines in six categories from free-to-read sources, sized for reading in the car.

features.title: Made for the touchscreen
features.text: Large touch targets and fonts sized for the Tesla screen, with light and dark modes that follow the car's display.

features.title: Private by design
features.text: No account. Your saved places and last location stay in your car's browser.

quickStart.title: Open it in your Tesla
quickStart.text: Open the browser on your Tesla's screen and go to the site. Bookmark it so it's one tap away.

quickStart.title: Set your location
quickStart.text: Allow location when asked, or tap Change location and enter a zip code or town. It's remembered for next time.

quickStart.title: Save your places
quickStart.text: On the Traffic tab, tap Add place and search for an address to save Home, Work and more for live drive times.

quickStart.title: Explore the tabs
quickStart.text: Switch between Weather, Traffic, News and Places. Tap a saved place for its details and the voice command to navigate there.
